=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:187-203 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: agents.md is inlined after the UNATTENDED EXECUTION OVERRIDE block with no displacement note, reintroducing STOP-and-ASK directives without explicitly marking them overridden.
  WHY: The reviewers agree this recreates the same conflict pattern already fixed in review_autofix.yml, and without a displacement note the model can pattern-match onto the later concrete ask directives.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1032 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The bare-path detection regex `^[a-z]` rejects uppercase-starting numbered path entries.
  WHY: This can prematurely terminate the files section for inputs like `1. API/foo.ts`, though the impact is narrow because backtick-wrapped paths still work and uppercase bare paths are uncommon.
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:145-178 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The unattended override block is omitted entirely when `unattended_llm_system_instructions.md` is missing, with no fallback or warning.
  WHY: In consumer checkouts that do not have the file, the model sees only the original STOP/ASK instructions and loses the override context.
- tests/test_implement_targeted_file_context_parser.py:43-55 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The parser-source extraction regex is hardcoded to the current YAML layout and can break on formatting changes.
  WHY: A workflow reformat could cause the test to extract the wrong body or nothing at all, masking parser regressions even though production behavior is unchanged.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:187-203 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The implement-phase static context inlines agents.md after the UNATTENDED EXECUTION OVERRIDE block with no displacement note.
  WHY: agents.md reproduces codex_system_instructions.md's STOP/ASK directives, so the model can see concrete ask rules again after the override and re-enter the stuck state.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1032 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The numbered-item path-entry heuristic uses `^[a-z]` which rejects uppercase-starting bare paths on numbered list items.
  WHY: A plan written as `1. API/foo.ts` would treat that line as a section terminator instead of a path entry, silently closing the files section.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1032 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regex requires paths to start with `[a-z]`, so uppercase-starting numbered entries like `1. API/utils.ts` are not recognized as path entries.
  WHY: This can prematurely close the files section and leave no files inlined, forcing Codex to fall back to shell exploration.
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:193-210 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The implement phase inlines the UNATTENDED EXECUTION OVERRIDE and later outputs `=== AGENTS.MD ===` without any displacement note.
  WHY: This re-introduces the same STOP-and-ASK rules the override is meant to displace, so the model may pattern-match onto the later directives and get stuck.
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:145-168 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If `unattended_llm_system_instructions.md` is missing, the script outputs nothing for the override section.
  WHY: The model then sees only the STOP/ASK rules from codex_system_instructions.md with no override context.
- tests/test_implement_targeted_file_context_parser.py:43-55 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The regex for extracting the awk parser source is hardcoded to specific whitespace/layout.
  WHY: A workflow YAML reformat could break test extraction while the production parser continues working.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:193-210 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: agents.md is inlined after the UNATTENDED EXECUTION OVERRIDE block without any displacement note.
  WHY: The override is followed by concrete STOP-and-ASK rules from agents.md, creating ambiguity about which directive takes precedence.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1032 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `is_path_entry` regex `/^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*\//` only matches paths starting with a lowercase letter.
  WHY: Uppercase-starting numbered path entries are misclassified as section terminators, so targeted file context is not extracted.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

  WHY: agents.md is a verbatim copy of codex_system_instructions.md's STOP-and-ASK rules, so the model can encounter competing policies and pattern-match the later concrete ASK directives.

  PROBLEM: The `is_path_entry` check only matches paths that start with a lowercase letter.
  WHY: Uppercase-starting bare paths on numbered lines are not recognized as path entries, so the parser terminates the section early and the targeted file context is incomplete.
